propositions: Stand up a real Jira 8.17.1 Data Center instance as a verification oracle for a DC adapter, since no DC license or official OpenAPI spec is available and Cloud v3 is not a substitute.
The harness image must be BUILT by vendoring a Dockerfile that FROMs the addono base by digest, not pulled, because pycontribs/jira-test-image:8.17.1 is a local build name published to no registry.

The vendored entrypoint must keep -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout with rationale comments, because their removal causes silent cold-start failure via the retired Marketplace v1 endpoint or Cargo's 600000ms deploy ceiling.

The harness cannot be verified on emulated arm64 (three runs failed at 25-55 minutes); a native amd64 runner is required, so acceptance evidence comes from a new external-integration.yml job on ubuntu-latest.

Live tests must SKIP (not fail) when the harness is absent, naming make jira-dc-up and REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1, and test_harness_smoke.py must define _live_jira_ready to participate in the all-skip canary; the pre-existing external job is fenced off with --ignore.

On native amd64 the harness built, booted, and answered REST: PAT bearer auth and DC deployment-type checks passed, but the smoke test's hardcoded projectTemplateKey failed, requiring dynamic template discovery so 3-of-4 passing is not yet done.
